001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.BoolVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
008import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
009import org.clafer.common.Util;
010
011/**
012 *
013 * @author jimmy
014 */
015public class PropOne extends Propagator<BoolVar> {
016
017    public PropOne(BoolVar[] vars) {
018        super(vars, PropagatorPriority.BINARY, true);
019    }
020
021    @Override
022    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
023        return IntEventType.instantiation();
024    }
025
026    private void clearAllBut(int exclude) throws ContradictionException {
027        for (int i = 0; i < vars.length; i++) {
028            if (i != exclude) {
029                vars[i].setToFalse(this);
030            }
031        }
032    }
033
034    @Override
035    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
036        int zeroes = 0;
037        int unassigned = 0;
038        for (int i = 0; i < vars.length; i++) {
039            BoolVar var = vars[i];
040            if (var.isInstantiated()) {
041                if (var.getValue() == 1) {
042                    clearAllBut(i);
043                    return;
044                } else {
045                    zeroes++;
046                }
047            } else {
048                unassigned = i;
049            }
050        }
051        if (zeroes >= vars.length - 1) {
052            vars[unassigned].setToTrue(this);
053            clearAllBut(unassigned);
054
055        }
056    }
057
058    @Override
059    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
060        if (vars[idxVarInProp].getValue() == 1) {
061            clearAllBut(idxVarInProp);
062        } else {
063            propagate(mask);
064        }
065    }
066
067    @Override
068    public ESat isEntailed() {
069        int count = 0;
070        boolean allInstantiated = true;
071        for (BoolVar var : vars) {
072            if (var.isInstantiated()) {
073                if (var.getValue() == 1) {
074                    count++;
075                    if (count > 1) {
076                        return ESat.FALSE;
077                    }
078                }
079            } else {
080                allInstantiated = false;
081            }
082        }
083        return allInstantiated
084                ? (count == 1 ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.FALSE) : ESat.UNDEFINED;
085    }
086
087    @Override
088    public String toString() {
089        return "one(" + Util.commaSeparate(vars) + ")";
090    }
091}
